# Adane Firde

> Communication strategist and creative director in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Helps businesses, NGOs and institutions decide what to say, then builds the system that keeps saying it. Co-founder of Youthopians. Every engagement starts with a 90-minute Strategy Session, online or in Addis Ababa.

- [Services](https://adanefirde.com/services/): Strategy Session; Sharpen track (Audit, Strategy, Content & Social System, Communication Blueprint); Build track (Brand Starter, Brand Foundation); Retainer
- [Case note: FarmerChat](https://adanefirde.com/work/farmerchat/): making Digital Green's AI farm advisor understandable to Ethiopian farmers
- [Case note: Reach for Change](https://adanefirde.com/work/reach-for-change/): brand audits, identities, workshops and pitch decks for green entrepreneurs
- [About](https://adanefirde.com/about/): background, beliefs, who the practice is for and who it isn't for
- [Book](https://adanefirde.com/book/): request a Strategy Session
- [Photography](https://adanefirde.com/photography/): portrait, documentary and brand photography
